caption:
I stopped planning dinner. it plans dinner.

#fitnessapp #mealprep #soma

slides.text:
I haven't planned
a dinner in weeks

It knows what's left
for today

Calories and protein,
not a diet

I log by describing it

"Salmon, rice, greens"
and it does the maths

Dinner comes from
what's in the fridge

Sized to what's left today

One step at a time

No scrolling back up
with wet hands

slides.heading: Food without the arithmetic
slides.body: SOMA sets the day's targets, logs what you ate from a sentence, and cooks dinner out of what you already have
